channel.title: Threat Desk
channel.description: Vulnerabilities, advisories and threat activity, twice a day

item.title: VulnCheck data shows credential harvesting becoming core exploitation trend
item.description: Requests to steal credentials rose from 1% to between 25% and 35% of vulnerability exploitation in 2026.

item.title: Hackers Abuse Microsoft and Mozilla Trusted Signing to Deploy Malware That Steals Browser Passwords
item.description: A Windows installer leverages trusted code signing to deploy a browser stealer targeting Brazilian users, with code pointing to a more serious goal of giving remote control of a hidden browser.

item.title: Unit 42 tracks AI agents accelerating corporate intrusions
item.description: Researchers identified autonomous AI agents used to expand access in over 10 campaigns, reducing command intervals from 23.9 seconds to 1.4 seconds.

item.title: Exposed attacker servers reveal US hospital credentials and cloud listing
item.description: Analysts at Hunt.io identified exposed web directories containing US hospital credential records, a manufacturer's Azure storage listing, and law firm target maps, highlighting the risks of exposed attacker infrastructure.

item.title: Drupal installer gap exploited after incomplete patch
item.description: Attackers are exploiting a residual flaw in Drupal's installer that was missed by last week's security update, allowing site takeover on systems in unusual states.

item.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody reports data breach
item.description: Zodia Custody confirmed a security incident exposing client and employee contact details, though it reported no unauthorised cryptocurrency transactions.

item.title: Bithumb confirms 15-day breach of internal collaboration system
item.description: South Korean exchange Bithumb disclosed that attackers accessed its DaouOffice system for 15 days, stealing passport numbers, bank details, and wallet addresses, raising significant phishing risks.

item.title: MalwareMustDie documents early LoongArch Linux RAT in EasyShell family
item.description: Researchers identified a Rust-based implant targeting LoongArch Linux, one of the earliest publicly documented remote access trojans for the architecture, highlighting new risks for non-x86 systems.

item.title: PolinRider malware hidden in GitHub pull requests for three open-source projects
item.description: Attackers inserted password-stealing malware into build workflows for AsyncAPI, CircuitVerse and Open Food Facts, with malicious installers published for download.

item.title: North Korea-linked PolinRider poisons 7,600 GitHub repos
item.description: SafeDep reports that threat actors linked to North Korea have compromised over 7,600 GitHub repositories to distribute malware via a Python loader.

item.title: Google mandates MCP or CLI for Workspace AI agents from February 2027
item.description: Google is restricting how autonomous AI agents access Workspace data, requiring them to use new Model Context Protocol servers or a command-line interface to enforce security controls.

item.title: Kaspersky detects Keenadu malware on over 220,000 Android devices
item.description: Preinstalled malware in Android firmware has surged 2.5-fold in a year, with Keenadu and Triada affecting 88% of infected devices, posing persistent risks to corporate fleets.

item.title: FIFA confirms cyberattack exposed limited personal and business data
item.description: FIFA has confirmed that hackers accessed internal systems, following a claim by the Handsome Boy Hacking Club that it stole over 12 GB of data.

item.title: CISA warns of critical unpatched flaw in Danfoss refrigeration controllers
item.description: CISA has issued an advisory for a critical, unpatched buffer overflow in Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA controllers, which have recently been targeted in attacks across European supermarkets.

item.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler in $43.9bn all-stock deal
item.description: The record-breaking acquisition combines endpoint security with zero-trust network access, aiming to create a single control plane to deploy and control AI.

item.title: Signal blocks OS AI agents from reading chats
item.description: Signal has implemented platform-specific measures to prevent iOS and Android AI agents from accessing user messages, citing a lack of control over data collection by operating system features.

item.title: Police disrupt 57 illegal streaming services in 11-country operation
item.description: Law enforcement from 11 countries disrupted 57 illegal IPTV services, identifying 321 websites and tracing over €26 million in cryptocurrency transactions.

item.title: ShinyHunters claims return via new Tor site after member arrests
item.description: The extortion group has relaunched its data leak site, using historical PGP keys to assert legitimacy following a series of international arrests targeting its members.

item.title: Unclassified CIA system breached in cyberattack, AP source says
item.description: A person familiar with the incident told the Associated Press that an unclassified CIA system handling open-source intelligence was compromised, though no classified data was accessed.

item.title: Attackers use stolen AI prompt credentials to probe AWS infrastructure
item.description: Security firm Dragos traced AWS API calls to credentials planted in AI prompts, revealing that attackers are harvesting secrets from AI hosting providers.

item.title: NCSC issues guidance to counter agentic offensive frameworks
item.description: The UK's National Cyber Security Centre has published an eight-point plan to help defenders mitigate the surge in automated attacks from agentic offensive frameworks.

item.title: Drupal RCE flaw CVE-2026-132165 actively exploited
item.description: CISA has added a critical Drupal vulnerability to its KEV Catalog after confirming active exploitation that allows site takeover via the installer.

item.title: Turnitin investigating unauthorised activity on customer-facing systems
item.description: Education technology firm Turnitin has disclosed unauthorised activity on certain customer-facing systems, with the University of Colorado Boulder monitoring its integration.

item.title: NCC Group: Ransomware claims rise 23% in October
item.description: A new report indicates a sharp increase in claimed ransomware incidents, driven by AI-assisted vulnerability discovery and the emergence of new extortion brands.

item.title: Fake WordPress plugin bypasses 2FA and serves malicious scripts
item.description: Wordfence identified a hidden plugin that creates valid login sessions without 2FA and relays attacker-controlled JavaScript to visitors.

item.title: New gang Inception denies ShinyHunters rebranding claims
item.description: Security researchers have theorised that the data theft and extortion group Inception is a rebrand of ShinyHunters, a claim the new crew has explicitly rejected.

item.title: US Treasury's FinCEN takes systems offline after cyber incident
item.description: The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network has disconnected some systems to investigate unauthorised access, causing temporary service disruptions and filing deadline extensions.

item.title: Ransomware hits Port of Santos and Argentinian pipeline
item.description: Industrial sectors in Latin America face a surge in ransomware, with recent attacks affecting major infrastructure in Brazil and Argentina.

item.title: Aikido finds 42 phishing pages on Hugging Face
item.description: Attackers used Hugging Face's DeepSite AI to create fake login pages for 28 brands, including Microsoft and Google, to harvest credentials.

item.title: ShinyHunters alleged return claimed as Inception denies ties
item.description: A new extortion group called Inception has emerged, while someone claiming to represent ShinyHunters has announced the group’s alleged return, prompting denial from Inception operators.
